deployment: Copy these configuration files, the approved recipe, and code/ into a GTE work directory; the absolute host paths are the recorded deployment and need adapting elsewhere. The public branch contains masks and metadata, not raw ISOD RGB/depth, Python environments, pretrained weights or private transfer credentials.
large_artifacts: Checkpoints and full training logs stay on GTE; the run metadata records their host and output path.
data_source: Raw RGB/depth source is downloaded separately; validation and test reference masks remain the published frozen versions.
